commits.headline: feat(difficulty): a difficulty mod with a slider for everything, presets and a seeded Chaos
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
Enemy count, damage to Ratchet and to enemies, enemy and Ratchet speed,
weapon and ammo prices, ammo per shot, max ammo, bolt drops, max health and
health pickups, each a multiplier with 1.0 the game's own; the presets Easy,
Retail, Hard and Brutal fill the sliders left at 1.0, and Chaos rolls them
for each level from a seed, with optional timed events. Each value is changed
where the game takes it, through OpenRAC's rac1 hook points (take_damage,
get_hit, take_ammo, record_death,…

commits.headline: docs(difficulty): every slider and preset, which mobys count as enemies, and the pool's room
commits.author: Veradictus

commits.headline: build: pin the mod SDK 1.2.0
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The mods build against interface 1.2 and still say 1.1 where their
manifests do: SDK 1.2 reports a mod's manifest interface, so the
lock-strafe, the item randomizer and the difficulty mod keep loading on a port of 1.1, and
their load tests expect that.

commits.headline: feat(keyboard-mouse): play with a keyboard and mouse
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
WASD moves as the left stick, eased from the keys with a walk key; the
mouse turns the camera as the right stick, with sensitivity, acceleration
and inverted Y, and holds the tilt; left click fires; right click held
opens the Quick Select and the mouse's direction picks its slot; Space
jumps, Escape pauses; the number keys and the wheel take a Quick Select
slot's item at once; a key swings the camera behind Ratchet. Every action
is a keybind setting of two binds with Left-handed and Arrow…

commits.headline: feat(difficulty): presets that fill the sliders, version 1.1.0
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
Easy, Retail, Hard, Brutal and Chaos are now the manifest's presets:
the launcher sets every slider and a new Chaos switch from them, so the
sliders show what plays. This replaces the Preset choice whose values
applied to every slider left at 1.0. With Chaos on, a slider moved off
1.0 still holds and the others roll per level. Enemy speed and weapon
prices step by 0.05 so Easy's 0.85 and 0.75 sit on the slider. The
manifest names its hook points by their stable ids. A test checks the
presets…

commits.headline: refactor(mods): keyboard-mouse and lock-strafe name hook points by stable id
commits.author: Veradictus

commits.headline: fix(keyboard-mouse): menus, scenes and movies by keyboard and mouse, version 1.1.0
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The keys followed only play: the title, whose mode is the boot program's
word, never had its menu keys; Escape was Start everywhere; nothing
skipped a scene or a movie. Now what a key presses follows where the game
is, read from the level's or the boot program's mode word: the title
starts on Space, Enter or Escape; menus, the vendor and the main menu
confirm on Enter or Space and go back on Escape or Backspace, a held
arrow repeating; a Quit? dialog goes on with Escape; cutscenes, movies,
the…

commits.headline: fix(keyboard-mouse): Enter and a click travel on the map, version 1.1.1
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The map travels on Circle, which only Fire gave, and Fire's left click
does not count in menus: travelling took a rebind. With the map focused
(its handler is DrawMapScreen), Enter and a click are Circle and Space
turns its page. The other pages that read Circle (the Quit page's quit,
a cycled setting's step back) get a menu bind of their own, Menu:
Circle, on E.

commits.headline: feat(live-splits): splits a LiveSplit timer a planet, version 1.0.0
commits.author: Lynder063
commits.body:
A mod of OpenRAC's native port that talks to a running LiveSplit and
splits the timer as the player goes from planet to planet, so a
speedrunner does not have to touch it.

What the mod reads of the game: the level's gameplay hook point (a
planet is reached) and the level the port has loaded (the planet was
left). The game loads a level's gameplay again when Ratchet dies, which
is not a new planet: the mod keeps the planet it last saw.

The mod speaks LiveSplit's own server protocol, over TCP…
